correctness.rationale: The original Bienvenu–Duchamps–Foutel-Rodier independent-parent construction gives n independent uniform U_j∈[n]\{j}, an edge for U_j<j, and independent relabeling. Conditional on a size-(a,b) randomized birth interleaving, nonroot internal parent choices are (a−1)!(b−1)!, while the two roots contribute E[(n−r_A)(n−r_B)]=(n²−1)(ab−1)/((a+1)(b+1)); dividing by (n−1)^n proves the exact prescribed unordered two-block probability. Counting labeled bipartitions with the equal-size factor 1/2 gives P(S_n=s|K_n=2)=c_n(s)w_n(s)/Z_n. The independent root-event count gives Z_n=((n−1)H_{n−2}−(n−2))/n. On 1≤s≤n/2, w_n(s)=1/(s+1)+O(1/n) uniformly and Z_n=log n+O(1), yielding P(S_n≤n^x|K_n=2)→x for 0<x<1 and endpoint convergence. Independent complete parent-vector enumeration n=3..6 matches the exact law.
